scope: Qualitative claim-scope audit; no hypothesis tests, p-values or population inference

items.finding: Per-input and R3 per-scene directions retained. AB is worse and AC slightly better; no aggregate-only superiority claim.
Five fixed workload variants are not treated as a random device/application population.
All 40 predeclared slots retained; no post-result selection of successful or winning cases.
Not applicable: no regression or conditioning-on-outcome causal analysis.
40/40 is the observed finite-cohort witness rate, not an estimated universal feasibility probability.
R3 selected for diagnostic explanation only; no new run or claimed before-after repair benefit.
Includes R3 loss, tiny R4 difference, original IO failure and all SA seeds; no discarded method slots.
No significance claims, new thermal scans or chosen winning seeds; all original per-input values shown.
R3 diagnosis explicitly exploratory. Next levels are recorded before new results as unconfirmed recommendations.
Energy decomposition is accounting. Domain exclusion does not isolate its causal share or prove an untested change helps.
No claim that observed energy results caused constraints or time caps; those are read from prior frozen rules.
